question: How can I add custom CSS files to customize the styling of my Fern documentation?
ground_truth: To add custom CSS files to your Fern documentation, create a `styles.css` file in your `fern/` directory, then specify its path in your `docs.yml` file using `css: ./styles.css`. You can also add multiple CSS files by using a list format like `css: [./css/header-styles.css, ./css/footer-styles.css]`.

metadata.cited_context: You can add custom CSS to your docs to further customize the look and feel. Add a `styles.css` file and include it in your `fern/` project. In `docs.yml`, specify the path to the `styles.css` file: `css: ./styles.css`. You can specify any number of custom CSS files: `css: [./css/header-styles.css, ./css/footer-styles.css]`.
